unit.label: Duration, free time & suggestions
unit.title: How Long Will You Be Away?
unit.description: 10 new this lesson words and forms. Ask how long, describe what happens during free time, and give simple suggestions for places and activities.

goal.meaning: You should go to a night market.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 9 Dialogue I–II and Vocabulary I–II (printed pp. 183–187), plus Grammar I–IV as relevant to time-when, basic duration, …的時候, and 有時候…有時候… (printed pp. 188–192). Object-repeat/separable-verb duration details and 要是…就… are explicitly deferred to the next source-continuation unit.

lessons.title: How Long?
lessons.subtitle: Ask for duration with 多久 and place a simple duration after the verb.

steps.prompt: Which question asks for the length of time?
steps.explanation: 多久 asks how long the activity lasts.

steps.prompt: In the basic duration pattern, where does 一個星期 go?
options: After the verb: 玩一個星期
steps.answer: After the verb: 玩一個星期
steps.explanation: A simple duration follows the verb it measures.

lessons.title: When You Have Time
lessons.subtitle: Attach 的時候 to a situation to make a time-setting phrase.

steps.prompt: Which phrase means “when we are on break,” rather than “how long is the break”?
steps.explanation: 的時候 makes a when-clause; 多久 asks for duration; 有時候 means sometimes.

steps.prompt: Which phrase means “when you have free time”?
steps.explanation: 有空 is have free time; append 的時候 to frame another event.

steps.prompt: What does 放假的時候 do in the sentence?
options: It sets the time: when/on break
steps.answer: It sets the time: when/on break
steps.explanation: …的時候 creates a time-setting phrase.

steps.prompt: Which phrase means “when I have free time”?
steps.explanation: 有空 + 的時候 means when there is free time / when one is free.

lessons.title: Sometimes This, Sometimes That
lessons.subtitle: Use the paired 有時候 pattern for alternating possibilities.

steps.prompt: Which sentence says I sometimes drink tea and sometimes drink coffee?
options: 我有時候喝茶，有時候喝咖啡。
我有時候喝茶，不喝咖啡。
steps.answer: 我有時候喝茶，有時候喝咖啡。
steps.explanation: The two 有時候 clauses describe different occasions. Either activity can be mentioned first; 又…又… does not express this alternation.

steps.prompt: Which sentence presents two activities that alternate on different occasions?
options: 我有時候在家看電視，有時候出去玩。
steps.answer: 我有時候在家看電視，有時候出去玩。
steps.explanation: Repeating 有時候 before both alternatives marks recurring possibilities.

steps.prompt: In the paired pattern, why is 有時候 repeated?
steps.explanation: Each 有時候 introduces one of the recurring alternatives.

lessons.title: Do You Have a Suggestion?
lessons.subtitle: Ask for advice with 建議 and give it with 應該.

steps.prompt: In 你有什麼建議？, how is 建議 used?
steps.explanation: 建議 is used as a noun here.

steps.prompt: Which sentence advises someone NOT to go there?
steps.explanation: 不 goes before 應該 to advise against an action.

lessons.title: Night Markets and Tea Houses
lessons.subtitle: Describe recommended places as special or distinctive.

steps.prompt: Which word means “night market”?
steps.explanation: 夜市 is a night market.

steps.prompt: Which word means “tea house”?
steps.explanation: 茶館 is a tea house; 館 is already familiar from 圖書館.

steps.prompt: Which description means “special / distinctive”?
steps.explanation: 特別 means special or distinctive; 有名 and 美 are different descriptions.

lessons.title: Decide Where to Take Someone
lessons.subtitle: Use 帶 for taking a person somewhere and 決定 for a decision.

steps.prompt: Which verb means “to take / bring someone”?
steps.explanation: 帶 introduces the person being taken or brought somewhere.

steps.prompt: Which word means “to decide”?
steps.explanation: 決定 means to decide.

steps.prompt: Which word means “girlfriend”?
steps.explanation: 女朋友 means girlfriend; 朋友 is the broader word friend.

lessons.title: Unit 27 Review
lessons.subtitle: Duration, free-time patterns, suggestions, and places

steps.prompt: Listen and choose the character you hear.
steps.explanation: 久 is jiǔ, as in 多久.

steps.prompt: Listen to the word and choose its first character.
steps.explanation: 應 is yīng in 應該.

steps.prompt: Listen and choose the character you hear.
steps.explanation: 決 is jué, the first character of 決定.

steps.prompt: Which component is on the left of 該?
steps.explanation: 該 has 言 on the left and 亥 on the right.

steps.prompt: Which question asks “How long?”
steps.explanation: 多久 asks for a duration.

steps.prompt: Which answer says we want to play for two weeks?
steps.explanation: 兩個星期 is a duration after 玩; 下個星期 and 星期二 say when.

steps.prompt: Which phrase means “when we are on break,” rather than “how long is the break”?
steps.explanation: 的時候 makes a when-clause; 多久 asks for duration; 有時候 means sometimes.

steps.prompt: What does …的時候 contribute?
steps.explanation: …的時候 turns a situation into a time-setting phrase.

steps.prompt: Which sentence says I sometimes drink tea and sometimes drink coffee?
options: 我有時候喝茶，有時候喝咖啡。
我有時候喝茶，不喝咖啡。
steps.answer: 我有時候喝茶，有時候喝咖啡。
steps.explanation: The two 有時候 clauses describe different occasions. Either activity can be mentioned first; 又…又… does not express this alternation.

steps.prompt: Which structure presents two recurring alternatives?
steps.explanation: The repeated 有時候 pattern presents activities that alternate on different occasions.

steps.prompt: In 你有什麼建議？, 建議 means:
steps.explanation: This is the noun use of 建議.

steps.prompt: Which sentence advises against an action?
steps.explanation: 不應該 means should not.

steps.prompt: Which word means “tea house”?
steps.explanation: 茶館 is a tea house.

steps.prompt: Which word describes making a decision rather than giving advice?
steps.explanation: 決定 means decide; 建議 is suggestion/advice and 應該 means should.

steps.explanation: 女朋友 means girlfriend.

newVocabulary.note: this lesson also uses the paired pattern 有時候…，有時候… for alternating possibilities.
In 你有什麼建議？, 建議 is used as a noun.

久.note: 久 is third-tone jiǔ. In 多久, it asks the length of time: how long?
久.memory: A short left-falling stroke leads into the bent middle stroke and the long final right-falling stroke.

parts.label: 丿
parts.name: first stroke
parts.description: The first left-falling stroke sets the upper-left edge.

parts.label: lower pair
parts.name: bent and final strokes
parts.description: The last two strokes open downward and to the right.

女.note: 女 is third-tone nǚ. In 女朋友 it forms the word for girlfriend.
女.memory: The first turning stroke creates the left curve; the next two strokes cross through the center.

parts.label: turn
parts.name: first turning stroke
parts.description: The first stroke bends through the left and lower part of the character.

parts.label: crossing pair
parts.name: crossing strokes
parts.description: The final two strokes cross the first stroke and balance the character.

建.note: 建 is fourth-tone jiàn. In 建議, the whole word is the noun “suggestion/advice” in this lesson.
建.memory: 聿 is the inner six-stroke body; 廴 wraps around its lower-left side with three finishing strokes.

parts.label: 聿
parts.name: inner component
parts.description: The first six strokes form 聿 in the center.

parts.label: 廴
parts.name: walking enclosure
parts.description: The final three strokes form the wrapping 廴 around the lower-left.

議.note: 議 is fourth-tone yì. Learn it with 建 as 建議, “suggestion/advice.”
議.memory: 言 is the seven-stroke left side; the larger 義 component fills the right.

parts.label: 言
parts.name: speech component
parts.description: The first seven strokes form 言 on the left.

parts.label: 義
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The remaining thirteen strokes form 義 on the right.

夜.note: 夜 is fourth-tone yè. 夜市 is the common word for a night market.
夜.memory: 亠 sits at the top, 亻 on the left below it, and the four-stroke lower-right group finishes with a long sweep.

parts.label: 亠
parts.name: top component
parts.description: The first two strokes form 亠 across the top.

parts.label: 亻
parts.name: left person component
parts.description: The next two strokes form 亻 below the top on the left.

parts.label: lower
parts.name: lower-right group
parts.description: The final four strokes form the lower-right group, including the long last stroke.

市.note: 市 is fourth-tone shì. In 夜市 it means market.
市.memory: 亠 forms the two-stroke top and 巾 forms the three-stroke lower section.

parts.label: 亠
parts.name: top component
parts.description: The first two strokes form 亠.

parts.label: 巾
parts.name: lower component
parts.description: The last three strokes form 巾 below.

應.note: Read 應 as first-tone yīng in 應該. The whole word means should or ought to.
應.memory: A broad thirteen-stroke upper body sits over 心, whose four strokes anchor the bottom.

parts.label: 䧹
parts.name: upper body
parts.description: The first thirteen strokes form the large upper component.

parts.label: 心
parts.name: heart component
parts.description: The last four strokes form 心 along the bottom.

該.note: 該 is first-tone gāi. Together, 應該 means should.
該.memory: 言 is the seven-stroke left side; 亥 is the six-stroke right side.

parts.label: 言
parts.name: speech component
parts.description: The first seven strokes form 言 on the left.

parts.label: 亥
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final six strokes form 亥 on the right.

特.note: 特 is fourth-tone tè. In 特別 it contributes the meaning special or distinctive.
特.memory: 牜 is the four-stroke left side; 寺 is the six-stroke right side.

parts.label: 牜
parts.name: cow component
parts.description: The first four strokes form 牜 on the left.

parts.label: 寺
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The last six strokes form 寺 on the right.

別.note: 別 is second-tone bié. In 特別, the two-character word means special or distinctive.
別.memory: The five-stroke left block sits beside the two-stroke 刂 knife component.

parts.label: 𠮠
parts.name: left component
parts.description: The first five strokes form the left block.

parts.label: 刂
parts.name: knife component
parts.description: The final two strokes form 刂 on the right.

決.note: 決 is second-tone jué. In 決定, the whole word means to decide.
決.memory: 氵 forms the three water dots on the left; 夬 forms the four-stroke right side.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: water component
parts.description: The first three strokes form 氵 on the left.

parts.label: 夬
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final four strokes form 夬 on the right.

u27-duration-basic.title: Say how long with a duration after the verb
u27-duration-basic.explanation: A time-duration expression tells how long an action lasts, not when it happens. In the basic this lesson pattern, the duration follows the verb directly. 多久 asks for that length of time. More complex cases with an explicit object, negation, and separable verbs are taught in the next continuation unit.

examples.meaning: How long do you want to have fun / be away?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wán yí ge xīngqí.
examples.meaning: I want to be away / have fun for one week.

u27-duration-basic.remember: When? goes before the action; how long? follows the verb in this basic pattern.

u27-de-shihou.title: Mark the time of an event with …的時候
u27-de-shihou.pattern: Event / Situation + 的時候，+ Main Clause
u27-de-shihou.explanation: Attach 的時候 to an event or situation to mean “when…” or “during the time when…”. The whole …的時候 phrase sets the time for the main clause.

examples.text: 放假的時候，我想出去玩。
examples.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhou, wǒ xiǎng chūqù wán.
examples.meaning: When I am on break, I want to go out and have fun.

examples.text: 有空的時候，我去看風景。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu kòng de shíhou, wǒ qù kàn fēngjǐng.
examples.meaning: When I have free time, I go look at the scenery.

u27-de-shihou.remember: Put 的時候 after the situation that answers “when?”

u27-you-shihou.title: Alternate possibilities with 有時候…有時候…
u27-you-shihou.pattern: 有時候 + A，有時候 + B
u27-you-shihou.explanation: this lesson uses two 有時候 phrases to present activities that alternate within the same general situation. The two clauses describe different things that happen on different occasions.

examples.text: 我有時候在家看電視，有時候出去玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou zài jiā kàn diànshì, yǒu shíhou chūqù wán.
examples.meaning: Sometimes I watch TV at home, and sometimes I go out.

u27-you-shihou.remember: Repeat 有時候 before each alternative when you want to contrast two recurring possibilities.

u27-yinggai.title: Give a suggestion with 應該
u27-yinggai.pattern: Subject + 應該 + Verb Phrase / Subject + 不應該 + Verb Phrase
u27-yinggai.explanation: 應該 introduces what someone should or ought to do. Put the suggested action after 應該. To say someone should not do something, put 不 before 應該.

examples.meaning: You should go to a night market.

u27-yinggai.remember: 應該 + action gives advice; 不應該 + action advises against it.

u27-how-long.meaning: How long do you want to have fun / be away?
u27-how-long.note: 多久 asks for a duration.

u27-one-week.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wán yí ge xīngqí.
u27-one-week.meaning: I want to be away / have fun for one week.
u27-one-week.note: The duration 一個星期 follows the verb 玩.

u27-break-when.text: 放假的時候，我想出去玩。
u27-break-when.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhou, wǒ xiǎng chūqù wán.
u27-break-when.meaning: When I am on break, I want to go out and have fun.
u27-break-when.note: 放假的時候 sets the time for the main clause.

u27-free-when.text: 有空的時候，我去看風景。
u27-free-when.pinyin: Yǒu kòng de shíhou, wǒ qù kàn fēngjǐng.
u27-free-when.meaning: When I have free time, I go look at the scenery.
u27-free-when.note: 有空的時候 means when I have free time.

u27-sometimes.text: 我有時候在家看電視，有時候出去玩。
u27-sometimes.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou zài jiā kàn diànshì, yǒu shíhou chūqù wán.
u27-sometimes.meaning: Sometimes I watch TV at home, and sometimes I go out.
u27-sometimes.note: The repeated 有時候 presents two alternating possibilities.

u27-suggestion-question.note: Here 建議 is a noun.

u27-should-night-market.meaning: You should go to a night market.
u27-should-night-market.note: 應該 comes before the suggested action.

u27-special-teahouse.meaning: The tea houses here are special.
u27-special-teahouse.note: 茶館 is tea house; 特別 describes it as distinctive.

u27-decide-night-market.text: 我決定帶女朋友去夜市。
u27-decide-night-market.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng dài nǚpéngyou qù yèshì.
u27-decide-night-market.meaning: I decided to take my girlfriend to a night market.
u27-decide-night-market.note: 女朋友 means girlfriend. 決定 + action means decide to do it; 帶 + person + 去 + place means take someone to a place.

u27-she-teahouse.meaning: She should go to a tea house.
u27-she-teahouse.note: A second simple 應該 suggestion.
